title: Prompt Control-Flow Integrity: A Priority-Aware Runtime Defense Against Prompt Injection in LLM Systems
authors: Md Takrim Ul Alam; Akif Islam; Mohd Ruhul Ameen; Abu Saleh Musa Miah; Jungpil Shin
why_relevant: Proposes a runtime middleware defense against prompt injection attacks, including indirect injection via RAG retrieved documents, enforcing priority among system/developer/user/retrieved segments.
why_not_or_caveat: Evaluated on a small custom synthetic benchmark; defense is generic to LLM APIs rather than RAG-specific, and claims (100% interception, 0% FPR) are limited in scope.
suggested_section: Adversarial corruption: defenses against indirect prompt injection
